purpose: Freeze all judgment-bearing browser-fixture geometry before the first MAT-01 specimen is materialized.

shared_layout.content_layer: relative z-index 2; family geometry is aria-hidden background structure

content_packet.heading: Primary content
content_packet.body: Supporting text remains unchanged across every material grammar.

tonal_fixture.rule: No family-specific hue; no visible specimen text uses metadata color over level_2 or level_3.

F2.perimeter_response: one level_3 edge witness on lower-inline edge only

F3.alignment: asymmetric vertical centers; no repeated grid

responsive_rules: At viewport <=520px every family row becomes one column; APP and WEB remain separate cells.
Candidate surfaces use width:100% and max-width only; no fixed width may exceed the viewport content box.
Family topology is unchanged at 320; only the already-frozen APP versus WEB amplitude values differ.
No content unit may be hidden, truncated, horizontally scrolled, or reordered at 320.
interaction_and_accessibility: No animation or transition declarations anywhere in the scored surface.
No candidate geometry is interactive or focusable.
Forced-colors may flatten grayscale fills; semantic content order and text remain available and family structure may not obscure content.
All required visible text uses the frozen ink color on normal-mode candidate surfaces; contrast floor is 4.5:1.
Candidate identity is decorative research only; meaning/function may not depend on material effect.
construction_freeze: After first specimen materialization, only mechanical repairs that restore this exact contract may occur. Family geometry, tonal assignments, topology, amplitude, content, and candidate count may not be retuned after viewing.
